observations.body: The name Jew, the law, and circumcision are tested. Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God, but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

payload.posture: Read Romans 2:17–29 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the name Jew, the law, and circumcision are tested. Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God, but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
